messages:
maria_sec: quick heads-up — NVD just posted xmlsec advisory (CVE-2026-0421). rough description: crafted signature leads to priv esc in signature parsing. link: https://nvd.example/CVE-2026-0421 :eyes:
jon_ops: thanks. quick scan: CVSS ~7.8 (high), EPSS ~0.62 and climbing. exploit chatter on a couple of feeds. marking as P1 for triage this cycle.
liam_research: I can repro a reduced PoC in a container, will push logs to the vuln-repros bucket in a few mins. seems to need a specific signature block ordering.
alice_sre: is xmlsec pulled into any public-facing path? auth-service uses it indirectly for SAML responses and our token validation path — cc @roman_dev
vuln-bot: NVD feed: CVE-2026-0421; severity: HIGH; references: 3; reported 2026-03-20. EPSS trend: +0.07 last 24h.
roman_dev: confirmed auth-service vendor-locks xmlsec 2.10.x. I have a draft bump to 2.12.0 + unit test that rejects malformed signature nodes. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/auth-service/pull/4287 (draft)
maria_sec: important: check KMS and audit logs for any anomalous signing operations. if an attacker can craft signatures, they may present forged assertions. look for mismatched key IDs and unexpected `sign` calls.
jon_ops: ops plan suggestion — canary deploy patch in us-west1, 5% traffic, monitor errors and latency. if error-rate or auth failures >0.5% for 10m then rollback. also prepare hotpatch for Dedicated customers (we can trigger a package push).
kevin_ciso: flagging for compliance: need backport plan for 1.x on-prem releases and a formal change record for customers with FIPS/KMS integrations. set me a draft CR by EOD.
sarah_prod: product note — customers on Dedicated may want scheduled maintenance windows; recommend communication draft ready.
liam_research: exploitability quick-check: ran container PoC with mounted sample keys; logs: `ERROR xmlsec: signature validation bypassed at line 42` then successful token acceptance. reproducer uploaded: s3://vuln-repros/xmlsec-0421/repro.tar.gz
alice_sre: telemetry knobs — add guard: emit audit event when signature validated with key not in allowed_key_list. will add query to prod dashboards. also schedule a short retention snapshot of `auth.sign` logs for the next 72h.
roman_dev: PR updated: added sanitization + defensive parsing and a feature flag `xmlsec_strict_mode`. will land as canary off by default, enabled for canary shard only.
jon_ops: ops runbook needs: `rotate_kms_keys.sh`, revocation plan for tokens (invalidate sessions), and rollback commands. I'll draft and attach.
maria_sec: action items consolidated: (1) @roman_dev — finish PR & backport PR for 1.x; (2) @alice_sre — canary rollout + telemetry + dashboard queries; (3) @jon_ops — ops runbook + KMS rotation checklist; (4) @kevin_ciso — compliance/backport sign-off + customer comm plan; (5) @liam_research — finalize repro and exploitability note. target: 24h patch cadence, otherwise emergency maintenance.
kevin_ciso: noted. I'll open CR and set the on-prem advisory template.
sarah_prod: SGTM on comms, will draft customer notice for Dedicated tomorrow morning.
maria_sec: thanks all. ping here when PR is merged and canary metrics look green. adding :thumbsup: to indicate ack.
